component.name: AVWOWE
component.summary: Interactive media player and kiosk system

description.p: AVWOWE turns media collections into nonstop on-screen magic.

ul.li: Always On: Point to local folders and cycle through media continuously. Optionally slice videos into automatic jump cuts for a custom montage look. Ideal for home screens, storefront displays, events, or ambient installations.
Advanced Tickers: Add scrolling text bars anywhere on screen. Pull content from static text, local files, or live URLs refreshed automatically. Customize fonts, colors, sizes, and background images.
Dynamic Overlays: Pin animated or static corner watermarks with full size and position control. Layer full-screen frames, festive borders, CRT scanlines, or film grain over the entire output.
Picture in Picture: Layer animated images that drift, spin, and tilt across the display in real time. Works with JPG, PNG, or GIF folders with full control over density, speed, and movement style.
Live Content & Remote Config: Automatically pick up added or removed files without restarting. Update settings on the fly or feed live text from remote URLs.
High-Fidelity Export: Export compositions as sequences of high-resolution, frame-accurate PNG frames for video rendering and distribution.

screenshot.caption: Point at any folder of photos and videos for instant, continuous playback
Automatic sequencing and pacing for a fluid, hands-off display
Layer animated images and pin your logo as a corner watermark
Scrolling text from a local file or live URL, refreshed automatically
Tune transitions, timing, and overlays, or update remotely via a config URL
